name: Scott Langston
reason: His own site (scottlangston.org, 5 Nov 2026) is an integrative counselling and therapy practice (CBT, IFS, DBT, MBCT, ACT, solution-focused therapy) alongside his job as a high-school counsellor in Bucharest; mindfulness appears only as part of therapy.
